input.prompt:
Create ONE complete finished 3200x1440 game screenshot, repainting our approved screen with substantially more faithful PASS THE FEAR / 风暴怕死队 hand-drawn art direction. Keep the accepted layout and gameplay content.

IMAGE AUTHORITY:
Image1: official Pass the Fear blacksmith. Primary authority for the actual UI material drawing, restrained dark card interiors, timber supports, muted bronze hardware, rough double contour line and 2D illustrated item language. Observe that the whole perimeter is NOT shiny gold.
Image2: official Pass the Fear blue stone-floor scene. Authority for confident economical ink strokes, large flat local-color shapes, angular 2-3 tone shading, blue/violet environmental grouping, simplified background detail, and 2D character integration.
Image3: official Chinese notebook. Authority for hanging paper tab construction, warm selected paper, cream text, compact typographic hierarchy and intentionally uneven drawn page edges.
Image4: OUR APPROVED SCREEN. Absolute authority ONLY for geometry, all words/numbers, item identities, character identities, room footprint, object positions and game state. It currently looks too uniformly polished and densely detailed. Repaint those surfaces and illustrations; do not simply retain its rendering with a dark filter. Do not transfer any game-specific text, items, currencies, characters or controls from Images1-3.

ART DIRECTION REFINEMENT:
1. Draw this as coherent final production 2D game artwork, like the official references. Confident pen contours have purposeful thick/thin changes: stronger on occluded lower edges, thinner in lit interiors; small sparse dry breaks at long edges. Angular shape rhythm, clean broad flat color, two or three deliberate value planes. Keep fine drawing at important junctions; broad calm spaces elsewhere. No sketch draft, no messy scribble, no cheap vector clip-art.
2. Flatten the excessive polished bevels. Frame timber is a muted umber flat surface with a FEW long grain strokes following construction. Bronze hardware is ochre/brown with one short dull edge accent, not a continuous golden rim. Use the same panel geometry and matching card rectangles but reduce the many nested highlight rails to the official reference's dark double-line drawing. Surfaces remain deep plum-brown. Avoid uniformly worn edge noise around every rectangle.
3. Item icons must be redrawn in the reference's compact illustrated style and share one artist's line weight. Our teal-green poison vial: slightly angular hand-drawn bottle contour, cork and gold wire neck retained, flat teal liquid and ONE small drawn reflection; no realistic transparent glass simulation or crystal shine. Pale mushroom: asymmetrically rounded cap, ONE broad gray underside shadow, a small number of decisive gill strokes; no dozens of realistic radial ridges. Silver dagger: familiar pointed blade, brass guard and leather grip; one large cool silver face and one narrow light blade edge, no polygon gemstone facets and no glossy 3D product rendering. Keep identities, hue roles and orientations recognizable. Shared icons are consistent reusable assets.
4. The dungeon must feel hand-drawn rather than a miniature 3D diorama. Preserve the layout, walkable footprint, exact objects and positions from Image4, but organize its stonework in larger quiet blue-gray/value groups. Ink some structural cracks and corners, not every brick face. Stone edges are uneven angular facets, not rounded pill-like chamfers. Group vines into a few opaque silhouettes rather than individually rendered identical leaves. Keep existing candles and props, but their light is localized; no orange outline shining along every wall. Preserve the spiral disk and round stone devices; never turn them into loot boxes or magic circles.
5. Our white-and-brass knight and exactly three red-hooded enemies remain the same identities and sizes/positions, redrawn with the official reference's flat colored inked sprite language and grounded compact shadows. Keep the enemy count exactly three. No new portrait, enemy, corpse, boss or character. Avoid smooth spherical toy shading.
6. Visual attention belongs to the actionable items/characters and readable text. Background detail is quieter than foreground art. Strong warm/cool accents are concentrated in the few existing functional icons and active states. Do not make every corner equally crisp, luminous or decorated. No added symbols, coins, chains, rivets, stars, sparkles, glow strips, random scratches or occult motifs.

LOCKED INTERFACE:
Three hanging-page tabs exactly 装备栏位 / 英雄属性 / 装备图鉴, first selected. Preserve current top-left location, tab widths, baseline and safe margins. Use the official compact Chinese headings, clean inked cream/gold letters; do not use ornate calligraphy or stretch each character into a logo.
Top right remains FOUR enlarged icon/value groups in exactly the same positions: 生命 180/180 full red bar; 体力 100/100 full cyan bar; 腐化 0/100 EMPTY outlined bar; 金币 4. Keep icon silhouettes at least as large as Image4, improve number legibility with slightly stronger and larger numerals within the existing groups. No extra currencies.
Left 战斗装备 and right 背包 stay the same size with aligned top/bottom edges, title baselines, card widths/heights and all four row baselines. SINGLE FULL-WIDTH COLUMN on each side, never two columns. Left rows: vial8 damage/1 greenvalue; mushroom4 greenvalue and NO damage; dagger30 damage/2 greenvalue/ONE purple enchantment mark/EMPTY0/100 bar; bottom LOCKED. Right rows1-3 EMPTY, bottom LOCKED. Never add labels or descriptions onto these equipped cards.
Middle title 遗迹. Bottom instruction exactly 按住瞄准 · 松手弹射. Keep all text clean and accurate.
Whole output should look like a carefully art-directed game screenshot belonging visually beside Images1-3, with a visible change in line economy, material flatness and contrast hierarchy from Image4. This is a quality refinement of approved UI, not a new layout.
